summary: Warnings for Encorafenib include the risk of developing new primary malignancies, which are new cancers that can appear on the skin or inside the body, as well as tumor promotion where certain non-mutated cancer cells grow faster [3]. Because of these risks, patients need skin evaluations and checks for new cancers before, during, and after therapy [3]. In addition, computer model predictions—which come from a small program rather than tests in people—rated the risk to the liver as high and the risk to the heart as low [M].
